<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Redirecting Draft](/Feats.aspx?ID=5536) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Prerequisites**
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527)

**Trigger**
You or an ally within 10 feet of you is the target of a ranged physical Strike.

</column>

---

You flap your wings to blow arrows off course. You or the triggering ally gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you redirected the attack's flight path.
name: Redirecting Draft
